title: Tutorial walkthrough
summary: Whether a beginner starting clean can finish the tutorial, with a table of each step's stated visible result and whether the walkthrough saw it. Two simulated beginner runs, per-step checks and a type check.
notes: A model is a weak stand-in for a beginner; one person new to the topic remains the better test.
Simulated: no sandbox ran the steps. Run runnable tutorials for real before publishing.

inputs.label: The starting state (what to install and already know)
inputs.help: State at the top what the learner needs installed and already knows.

inputs.label: The end result
inputs.help: State at the top what the learner will have built or done by the end.

config.persona: a beginner starting from a clean environment using only the stated prior knowledge
config.task: Work through the tutorial from the first step to the end result.
rules: for each step record the stated visible result and whether you would see it

fields.name: instruction
fields.label: Instruction
fields.description: What the step tells the learner to do

fields.name: stated_result
fields.label: Stated result
fields.description: The visible result the step says the learner will see

fields.name: has_choice
fields.label: Offers a choice
fields.description: Whether the step offers the learner a choice or alternative

checklist.label: A visible result is stated
checklist.question: Does the step state the visible result the learner will see?

checklist.label: Commands and code are complete
checklist.question: Are the step's commands and code complete enough to run as written?

checklist.label: No choice offered
checklist.question: Is the step free of choices or alternatives?

config.instructions: Classify each passage by its role in a tutorial.

config.persona: a second beginner from a clean environment
config.task: Work through the tutorial again from a clean start and compare the result with the first run.
rules: record the tool and library versions the text assumes
